snippet.title: Mighty Mage - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Mighty Mage is a top-down arena shooter rogue-lite where you play a cute mage wielding up to 5 elemental spells at a time to fight off hordes of enemies.

In this rogue-lite arena survival game, select from a variety of upgrades, select different spells to become stronger, and create overpowered builds every run.

Developed and published by Antonio Filipe / AFIL Games
Also released on Nintendo Switch, PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #theforeseenarcade #mightymage
